card.name: Spaces before numbers in dosing text
card.fires_on: The space or small linking word just before a number or drug name in dosing and preparation text, such as after 'equal to', 'Every', 'to', or 'and'. It appears in IV dosing tables and dilution instructions.

modes.label: Space before a dose number
modes.description: A bare space token right before a number such as an interval, range or renal cutoff.
modes.example: CLcr greater than or equal to<< >>15 mL/min and less than

modes.label: Linking word in preparation steps
modes.description: A small word like 'by', 'with' or 'using' in dilution or infusion instructions.
modes.example: delivered<< by>> controlled intravenous infusion using an infusion pump

modes.label: Start of a brand name or bracket
modes.description: An opening bracket or the first piece of a brand name in dosing text.
modes.example: Administer all doses of<< Z>>ERBAXA every 8 hours
